message:
Last winter, I was sitting snugly in my living room, sipping tea while the snowstorm raged outside. Suddenly, my phone decided it was the perfect time to die—right when I needed the weather updates the most! I had to resort to the good old-fashioned radio. 

It got me thinking about how reliant we become on technology. I now keep a little notepad with important numbers and info tucked away with my emergency supplies. Old school? Maybe. But it’s nice to have a backup plan that doesn’t need charging! 

What’s your go-to trick for staying prepared when the tech decides to take a nap? 😊
